product_boundary: exactly one executable file named EntityOS

product_deltas.claim: platform-scoped exact single-wheel filename plus SHA-256 candidate authority for the six build and ten full-pytest distributions
deterministic source regression binding lock scope, exact distribution sets, wheel-only shape, fail-closed policy and zero-new-experiment accounting to the existing requirements closure

primary_source_basis.uv: Official uv CLI/settings documentation: --require-hashes requires a matching hash for every exact requirement and hash-checking is all-or-nothing; --only-binary :all: / --no-build rejects source-distribution builds for registry dependencies; --default-index can explicitly bind the registry authority.
primary_source_basis.pypi: Official PyPI release JSON metadata supplied exact wheel filenames and SHA-256 digests for the ten locked distributions.
primary_source_basis.important_nonclaim: The PyPI metadata and source lock do not prove which artifact an EntityOS Sandbox actually installed. Promotion requires hash-enforced provisioning plus exact-head Vercel Sandbox receipt binding.

architecture_outcome.preferred_mechanism: Generate or validate an exact single-hash requirements surface from EntityOSPythonArtifactLock/v1, provision with uv hash-checking and wheel-only policy against the explicitly admitted index, then verify the installed distribution set and bind both artifact-lock digest and installed-set receipt into the EntityOS batch result.
architecture_outcome.counterhypothesis: A committed hash manifest can become decorative provenance if the installer does not consume it or if ambient index configuration can select an unbound source.
architecture_outcome.falsifier: Wrong hash, missing hash, source-distribution substitution, ambient alternate index, extra distribution and lock/requirements disagreement must all fail before EntityOS build/test promotion.

vercel_observation.interpretation: A READY deployment on another branch is neither proof that the current #787 artifact-lock head executed nor EntityOS Sandbox evidence. No deployment newer than that READY observation had been returned for commits 3aeef6f1 or 1ba6e1ef at receipt time.

next_executable_steps: wire the active #787 build and full-pytest provisioning to consume the artifact lock with explicit hash-checking, wheel-only and index-authority enforcement without creating a second EntityOS lane
run deterministic fail-closed controls for wrong/missing hash, sdist substitution, alternate index and artifact-lock versus requirements disagreement
on an actually-started exact-head Vercel Sandbox, capture artifact-lock digest, exact installed-set receipt, full pytest with zero skips and new_unusual_experiment_count=0
if the lock-enforced candidate reaches the one-file path, perform the existing Git-free attested twin EntityOS build plus runtime/self-test/no-host-Python/relocation and exact artifact digest gates
